data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: When this story is complete, read-config.sh when invoked against a missing dso-config.conf directs the user to run /dso:onboarding (non-zero exit with message)

## Summary
Add a new test function to tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh that verifies
read-config.sh dso.workflow exits non-zero with a message directing to /dso:onboarding
when no dso-config.conf is present. This behavior is implemented in S1
(8607-5358-5d67-4987) — this task writes the verification test.

The test will FAIL until S1 is merged. Adding it here with a RED marker in
.test-index is the correct pattern: the test defines the contract surface that S1
must satisfy.

## Implementation Steps

1. In tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh, add a new test function:
   test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding

2. The test must:
   a. Create a temporary directory that does NOT contain dso-config.conf
   b. Set WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE to "$TMPDIR_FIXTURE/nonexistent-dso-config.conf"
      (uses the existing WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE override pattern already in this test file)
   c. Run: bash "$SCRIPT" dso.workflow 2>&1
      Capture both exit code and combined output
   d. Assert exit code is NON-ZERO (not 0) — this is the new behavior S1 adds
   e. Assert combined output (stderr) contains the string 'onboarding' (case-insensitive)

3. Also add test_dso_workflow_missing_config_no_key_fallback — a guard test ensuring
   that ONLY the dso.workflow key (not arbitrary keys) triggers the non-zero exit:
   a. Run: bash "$SCRIPT" some.other.key with the same missing config
   b. Assert exit code is 0 (existing behavior for non-dso.workflow keys preserved)

4. Update .test-index to add a RED marker for the new tests:
   Append to the plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh line in .test-index:
   [test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding]
   (fuzzy match of 'readconfigsh' in 'testreadconfigsh' already works —
   the RED marker signals the test is expected-fail until S1 ships)

5. Call both new test functions in the test file (before any print_summary).

## TDD Requirement
The new test functions are the deliverable. After writing:
  bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
  Expected to EXIT NON-ZERO (RED) because S1 has not yet updated read-config.sh
  to emit a non-zero exit for missing config with dso.workflow key.

The RED marker pattern:
  Add [test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding] to .test-index
  for plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh BEFORE committing.

## Notes
- This story depends on S1 (8607-5358-5d67-4987). DD3 behavior is IMPLEMENTED in S1.
  This task only WRITES THE TEST. The test will fail until S1 is merged.
- Existing test test_read_config_missing_file_exits_gracefully currently asserts
  exit 0 on missing file for generic keys. The new test asserts non-zero exit
  specifically for the dso.workflow key — these are NOT contradictory; the S1
  implementation will make dso.workflow key special while preserving exit 0 for
  other keys.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b' || true  # Note: new tests expected RED until S1 ships
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding function exists in test-read-config.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding' tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
- [ ] Test asserts non-zero exit for dso.workflow key against missing config
  Verify: grep -A20 'test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding' tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh | grep -qE 'ne 0|non-zero|exit.*1|assert.*exit'
- [ ] Test asserts stderr contains 'onboarding' reference
  Verify: grep -A20 'test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding' tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh | grep -qi 'onboarding'
- [ ] Guard test test_dso_workflow_missing_config_no_key_fallback exists and asserts exit 0 for non-dso.workflow keys
  Verify: grep -q 'test_dso_workflow_missing_config_no_key_fallback' tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding] for read-config.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_dso_workflow_missing_config_directs_to_onboarding\]' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] Running test-read-config.sh exits non-zero (RED — S1 not yet merged)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh; test $? -ne 0
data.title: Add UPDATE test to test-read-config.sh verifying missing-config directs to /dso:onboarding (DD3)
